title: Straight-line homotopy G = F₀∘tl + t·(F₁ − F₀)∘tl is C^∞, with DG(cons(s,x))e₀ = F₁(x) − F₀(x) and DG(cons(s,x))(ιv) = (1 − s)DF₀(x)v + sDF₁(x)v
statement:
Let m, m′ ∈ ℕ and let F₀, F₁ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)).

Notation:
- ℝ^p := Eucl p = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p).
- For y ∈ ℝ^{m+1}: t(y) := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y 0 and tl(y) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y)).
- For s ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m: cons(s, x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)).
- ι(v) := cons(0, v) for v ∈ ℝ^m, and e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{m+1}.
- D := fderiv ℝ.

Let G : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m′}, G(y) := F₀(tl y) + t(y)·(F₁(tl y) − F₀(tl y)). This is the straight-line homotopy from F₀ to F₁, written exactly as the map G of dph_sh_affine_estimate.

Then G is C^∞, and for all s ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m:
- DG(cons(s, x))(e₀) = F₁(x) − F₀(x);
- DG(cons(s, x))(ι(v)) = (1 − s)·DF₀(x)(v) + s·DF₁(x)(v) for every v ∈ ℝ^m.
